groups.dataMinimization.label: Data minimization principle
groups.deliveryMethod.description:
NB: Under Article 5(1)(c) of the GDPR (data minimization principle), personal data processing must be proportionate and limited to what is strictly necessary for your stated purpose. Only adequate, relevant, and necessary data may be accessed via the E-Service.

Therefore:
(i) you may select "clear" or "pseudonymized" data only if aggregated or anonymous data are insufficient for the purposes stated in point 1;
(ii) you may select "clear" data only if pseudonymized data are also insufficient.

groups.personalDataAccess.description: NB: Under Art. 4(1)(1) of the GDPR, personal data means any information about an identified or identifiable person, directly or indirectly, by reference to an identifier (e.g., a name, identification number, location data, online identifier) or one or more factors specific to their physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural, or social identity. Therefore, personal data includes not only data that directly identifies an individual but also data that can be linked to an individual only indirectly through third parties (e.g., vehicle license plate number, employee number, or other alphanumeric code assigned by a third party).
